faq.q: What is the origin of Kerem?
faq.a: Kerem is associated with Arabic. Kerem is Arabic كَرَم (Karam), meaning 'generosity, nobility'. It is widely used as a male given name in Turkey.
Yes — the underlying form كَرَم is Arabic.
Kerem can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Kerem should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. The root ك ر م is Quranic, but Karam is not itself a Quranic personal name.
